Smt. Kavita Pali vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19
December, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:33751

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Ashish Shroti

On The 19th Of December, 2025
 Writ Petition No. 47904 of 2025
 Smt. Kavita Pali
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Brajmohan Mahajan - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Naval Kishor Gupta- Ga for the respondents/State
 Order

Petitioner has filed this writ petition challenging the order dated 27/10/2015, whereby, she has been asked to report back for duty on her substantive Aanganwadi Centre as a regular incumbent has been appointed at the place of her attachment.
2.
Facts necessary for decision of this case are that the petitioner was appointed as Aanganwadi Karyakarta for Aanganwadi Centre Peetal Karkhana No.1, Ward No.26, Shahari-3, Morar, Gwalior on 4/3/2014.

entities.text: Aanganwadi Centre Peetal Karkhana No.1, Ward No.26, Shahari-3,
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: She was thus performing her work at the said Aanganwadi Centre.

3. It appears that there was some incident occurred with the petitioner of which she lodged a complaint with the Police on 19/10/2022 in relation to an offence registered at Crime No. 540/2022 punishable under Sections 376(2)(i), 506, 406, 341, 354, 294, 323 of IPC with Jhansi Road Police Station, Gwalior.

It is stated by the petitioner that after investigation, challan NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:33751 2 WP-47904-2025 was filed and the trial is pending before the learned Trial Court in S.T. No.165/2023.
4.
It is the case of the petitioner that the accused in the aforesaid criminal case resides about 60-80 meters away from her Aanganwadi Centre.
She was being threatened to compromise the matter and thus, she was facing life threat.
She, therefore, requested respondent no.3 to post her at any other Aanganwadi Centre for security reasons.
Her request was favourably considered and she was attached at Aanganwadi Centre at Hanuman Ghati of Ward No.22, Sector 1, Gwalior on 18/11/2022 (Annexure P/3).

sentences.text: Because of the attachment of the petitioner at other Aanganwadi Centre, the work at Peetal Karkhana Aanganwadi Centre was adversely affected.
Consequently, she was reverted back to her own Aanganwadi Centre in January' 2024 (Annexure P/4).

However, from the averments made in the writ petition, it appears that the petitioner did not join at her Aanganwadi Centre and stayed at home.
6.
On 31/12/2024, the petitioner again requested respondent no.3 to post her at Aanganwadi Centre No.2, Naka Chandravadni, Ward No.57, Project Shahar-5, Gwalior (Annexure P/5).

The Collector again took a sympathetic view in the matter and in order to prevent the petitioner from any threat,
vide order dated 21/2/2025 (Annexure P/7) issued by the Joint Director of Women and Child Development Department, the petitioner was attached to Aanganwadi Centre Naka Chandravadni.

She has been working there since then.
7.

The advertisement was issued by the respondents for appointment of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:33751 3 WP-47904-2025 Aanganwadi Karyakarta at various Aanganwadi Centres including the one at Naka Chandravadni.
One Smt. Archana Prajapati has been selected for appointment on the said post.

Resultantly, vide impugned order dated 27/10/2025 (Annexure P/1),
petitioner has been asked to report back to her Aanganwadi Centre at Peetal Karkhana.

The petitioner is therefore, before this Court challenging the order dated 27/10/2025.
8.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has vehemently argued that the impugned order has been passed violating right to life of petitioner ensured under Article 21 of the Constitution of India.

He submitted that the petitioner has security threats at Peetal Karkhana Aanganwadi Centre and considering the same, she was attached earlier at Hanuman Ghati Aanganwadi Centre and subsequently at Naka Chandravadani Centre.
It is his submission that since the petitioner was already posted at Naka Chandravadani Aanganwadi Centre, the respondents should not have invited applications for appointment on the said post.

It is his submission that the impugned order has been passed in violation of Order dated 27/2/2025 (Annexure P/8), inasmuch as the attachment of petitioner at Naka Chandravadni was till normalization of the situation.
The learned counsel further submitted that before issuance of impugned order, the Project Officer ought to have obtained instructions from the higher officials.
He thus, submitted that the impugned order is violative of his right to life, and therefore, liable to be set aside.

9. The learned counsel for the State, appearing on advance notice, on the other hand opposed the submissions made by petitioner's counsel and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:33751 4 WP-47904-2025 submitted that petitioner's appointment was for a particular Aanganwadi Centre and she cannot claim appointment at any other center.
He pointed out that looking to the petitioner's difficulty, she was attached to the other Aanganwadi Centre, however, that does not give her any right to remain their permanently.
He also submitted that the incident occurred with the petitioner in October' 2022 and after lapse of more than 3 years, the situation must have normalized.

He also argued that since the regular incumbent has been selected and appointed for Naka Chandravadni, there is no post available for petitioner and, therefore, she is required to be posted back at her own center for which she was initially appointed.
He thus, prayed for dismissal of this writ petition.

sentences.text: Considered the arguments on admission.
11. It is seen that the petitioner's appointment on the post of Aanganwadi Karyakarta was for a particular Peetal Karkhana Aanganwadi Centre.
The petitioner's counsel could not point out any provision, whereunder, transfer of a Aanganwadi Karyakarta is permissible.
Looking to the personal difficulty of the petitioner, purely on humanitarian ground, earlier she was temporarily attached to Aanganwadi Centre at Hanuman Ghati and later at Naka Chandravadni Centre.
However, now since the regular incumbent has been selected and appointed at Naka Chandravadni Centre, the respondents are justified in asking the petitioner to go back to her Aanganwadi Centre.
12. The petitioner has filed copy of the complaint lodged by her at Police Station Kampoo, Gwalior on 14/1/2025 (Annexure P/6).

The NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:33751 5 WP-47904-2025 averments made therein show that still accused is pressurizing her to compromise the matter even when she is posted at Naka Chandravadni Aanganwadi Centre.
Thus, merely shifting of the petitioner from Aanganwadi Centre Peetal Karkhana has not solved her problem.
She is, therefore, required to be strong enough to face the situation.

13. The learned counsel for the State is justified in submitting that the petitioner has no right to remain at Aanganwadi Centre Naka Chandravadni, particularly when a regular incumbent has been posted there.

He has obtained instructions from respondent no.3 and has submitted that applications were invited for all the Aanganwadi Centers, where, the posts were lying vacant,
therefore, the petitioner is required to join at her substantive center at Peetal Karkhana.
14.

Considering the aforesaid, particularly the fact that the petitioner cannot remain attached to other Aanganwadi Centre for indefinite time, the impugned order dated 27/10/2025 cannot be said to be illegal or otherwise unsustainable in law.
It is more than three years when the incident occurred with the petitioner, she has been accommodated by the respondents at other post temporarily purely on humanaterian grounds.
However, because of petitioner's temporary attachment to other center, the working of her own center at Peetal Karkhana is also adversely affected.
Besides this, now the new incumbent is required to be posted at Naka Chandravadni.
Therefore, the petitioner is required to submit her joining at Peetal Karkhana Aanganwadi Centre.
She is however at liberty to request the SP, Gwalior to provide her security in case, she face any threat from the accused persons.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:33751 6 WP-47904-2025 The SP would deal with the same in accordance with law.
15. In view of discussion made above, the impugned order dated 27/10/2025 does not warrant any interference by this Court and the same is upheld.
Petition is disposed of with the aforesaid observations.

(ASHISH SHROTI) JUDGE JPS/-
